Officially the 'Priest of Arisetsu' skill, this represents your attunement with Arisetsu, the goddess of Warmth and Hope. You must be wearing a holy symbol -- and NOT wearing a Necromancy Gem -- to use Priest abilities. Holy symbols are most often found as jewelry, but can also be found on armor and weapons.
